title: SD+Kling made Teaser Trailer for my AI-Powered RPG Demo: Find settlements, go on quests, collect materials, and craft items
author: Lemon30

comments.author: oniris
comments.body: So that's what you've been spending time on, instead of getting at least a semblance of an inventory and player stats to work...

replies.author: Lemon30
replies.body:
Hey, they are both ready and being used behind the scenes. 

I made them first actually but I couldn't really get it to work in a logical way, bound with reasonable rules.

It isn't about, let's create a weapon and stats system and have a fight with gpt. I need another week at least to deal with combat, item stats, leveling, and crafting to put out something.

So in short, there is a system behind, I'm just not happy with it yet so I didn't make it public in this release.

replies.author: oniris
replies.body: I had a feeling you were working on it behind the scenes, it's just so unnatural for me to do the stakhavovist naggy voice that I thought I'd give it a go.
